subtitle: Out Manila · Philippine Airlines
overview: This 4-day no-shopping tour flies Philippine Airlines from Manila to Xiamen, then crosses by ferry to Jinmen (Kinmen), Taiwan. You see Jyuguang Tower, the Golden Gate Bridge to Lieyu Township, Jiugong Tunnel and the Cidi Triangle Fortress, then return to Xiamen for two nights at the 5-star Kempinski Hotel, with free time at an outlet mall, Zhongshan Road and a hot spring soak. One meal is upgraded to lobster seafood.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Nov 14–17 2026 to Nov 14–17 2026. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

itinerary.title: Manila – Xiamen – Jinmen
items: Meet the tour guide at Xiamen airport
Jyuguang Tower, with distant views of Jinmen
Zhongshan Memorial Forest: Ching-kuo Memorial Hall, Rushan Historic Fort, fighter jet, anti-aircraft gun and tank display areas

itinerary.title: Jinmen – Lieyu – Jinmen – Xiamen
items: Jinmen tea house, learning the history of the Military Recreation Centers
Cross the Golden Gate Bridge, the newest Jinmen landmark linking Greater Jinmen and Lieyu Township
Lieyu Township: Badalouzi, Shengli Gate and the August 23 Artillery Battle Victory Memorial
Shuangkou Beach Park, Jinmen’s closest beach to Xiamen Island
Jinmen specialty: kaoliang products (face masks, enzymes and more)

itinerary.title: Xiamen
items: Free time at the outlet mall

placeDesc.Jyuguang Tower: A landmark tower in Jinmen with distant views of the island's scenery.
placeDesc.Zhongshan Memorial Forest: A forest park in Jinmen with Ching-kuo Memorial Hall, a fort and displays of military hardware.
placeDesc.Ching-kuo Memorial Hall: A memorial hall in Zhongshan Memorial Forest, Jinmen, visited on Day 1.
placeDesc.Rushan Historic Fort: A historic fort in Zhongshan Memorial Forest, Jinmen.
placeDesc.Golden Gate Bridge (Jinmen): Jinmen's newest landmark bridge, connecting Greater Jinmen and Lieyu Township.
placeDesc.Lieyu Township: The smaller island of the Jinmen group, reached by the Golden Gate Bridge.
placeDesc.Badalouzi: A stop in Lieyu Township passed on the way to the artillery battle memorial.
placeDesc.August 23 Artillery Battle Victory Memor: A memorial in Lieyu Township to the August 23 artillery battle.
placeDesc.Jiugong Tunnel: A tunnel site in Lieyu Township visited on Day 2.
placeDesc.Shuangkou Beach Park: Jinmen's closest beach to Xiamen Island.
placeDesc.Cidi Triangle Fortress: A fortress site on Jinmen, visited on Day 2.
placeDesc.Model Street: A street in Jinmen with shops, visited together with local specialty stops.
placeDesc.Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street: Xiamen's main pedestrian shopping street in the old city.
placeDesc.Xiamen hot springs: A relaxing hot-spring soak in Xiamen on Day 3.
